insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Base Sum Insured: 50 Lacs, 75 Lacs, 1 Crore, 2 Crores, 3 Crores, 4 Crores, 5 Crores, 6 Crores (as per Product Benefit Table)

great.name: Room Rent
great.quote: Room Rent Actuals up to Sum Insured
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Hospitalization Treatment
great.explanation: Room rent is payable at actuals up to the sum insured without any category restriction or capping. This means you can choose any room type without worrying about daily rent limits.

great.name: Restore Benefit
great.quote: Super Reload (Unlimited Refill) From 2nd claim of Policy Life - Unlimited times
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | In-built Benefits
great.explanation: The policy provides unlimited reloads of the base sum insured after the first claim during the policy year. This ensures extra coverage if your sum insured is exhausted.

great.name: Consumables
great.quote: Non-payable items will be covered (all 4 lists of Annexure I)
great.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Hospitalization Treatment
great.explanation: Non-payable consumables and non-medical items listed in Annexure I are covered. This reduces your out-of-pocket expenses during hospitalization.

great.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
great.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Pre-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 90 days immediately prior to the date of such Hospitalization.
great.explanation: Medical expenses incurred up to 90 days before hospitalization are covered. This helps cover diagnostic and treatment costs leading up to your hospital stay.

great.name: Built-in SI Buffer
great.quote: If the Base Sum Insured is completely exhausted or is insufficient for covering a claim, then We shall provide for a reload amounting to the Base Sum Insured (“super Reload”), unlimited times during the Policy Year
great.explanation: Extra sum insured is automatically provided after the base sum insured is exhausted, with unlimited reloads during the policy year. This offers strong financial protection for multiple claims.

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Pre Existing Disease (PED) Waiting Period 3 years
good.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | Waiting Period - Inbuilt Cover
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are covered after a waiting period of 3 years. This is a standard industry practice and not a concern.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: 30-day Waiting Period (Code-Excl03) ... Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except for accidents. This is a common waiting period in health insurance policies.

good.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
good.quote: The Company shall indemnify the Post-Hospitalization Medical Expenses incurred... for up to 180 days from the date of discharge from the Hospital.
good.explanation: Medical expenses up to 180 days after hospital discharge are covered. This allows you to claim follow-up treatment costs for a good duration.

bad.name: No Claim Bonus
bad.quote: Super Reload (Unlimited Refill) ... | HealthReturnsTM ... Applicable up to 100% of the premium
bad.reference: Annexure III - Product Benefit Table (VIP) | In-built Benefits
bad.explanation: The policy does not mention any No Claim Bonus or cumulative sum insured increase on renewal. This means your sum insured may not grow automatically if you do not claim.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-Payment: means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the Policyholder / Insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: Co-payment is defined but the policy does not clearly state if any co-pay applies to domestic hospitalization by default. Please check your policy schedule for details.
